run.name: FS KKR Capital Corp
run.title: CP-OS host session (FSK)
run.summary: Creditors look adequately protected in the near term but the credit is weakening: liquidity of USD 3,308 million covers 2027 maturities, while net asset value, income and covenant headroom are eroding. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash of 102 plus foreign currency of 9, excluding 61 of restricted cash that collateralises derivatives. Availability is Callowhill 63 plus revolver 3,134, the revolver being net of 50 of standby letters of credit.

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant definitions, the borrowing base, ratings and common stock ownership are not supplied, so headroom is a proxy and confidence stays at medium.
CP-1 main limitation: No EBITDA exists; covenant definitions and borrowing base values are not supplied, so headroom rests on the reported equity figure and asset coverage ratios only.
